gaps.explanation: p11 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints five major fund columns (Electric, Gas, Water, Sewer, Ethanol) that have no schedule of their own; detail[] only holds the nonmajor combining statement (p21, Solid Waste 203,789 + Meter Deposit 956 = 204,745). Missing revenues by column (p11): Electric 4,233,876 + 40,790 + 5,739 + 7,003 = 4,287,408; Gas 1,666,451 + 1,037 + 57,521 + 627 = 1,725,636; Water 433,625 + 15,019 = 448,644; Sewer 402,955 + 2,161 + 3,701 = 408,817; Ethanol 614,288 + 164,242 = 778,530; sum 7,649,035. 204,745 + 7,649,035 = 7,853,780 vs statement 7,853,781: difference 1 is printed rounding (p11 Other Proprietary Funds utility sales 203,715 vs p21 Solid Waste 203,714). Transfers of these columns (p11: Electric in 42,000 / out (627,760), Gas out (230,000), Water in 211,579 / out (75,000), Sewer in 288,855 / out (148,000), Ethanol out (557,325)) are not added because this report has no business-type transfers gap row.

gaps.explanation: Same p11 proprietary statement: the Electric, Gas, Water, Sewer and Ethanol columns have no schedule; detail[] holds only the nonmajor Solid Waste Fund (p21, 213,819). Missing expenses by column (p11): Electric total operating expenses 3,708,469 + interest expense 24,083 = 3,732,552; Gas 1,337,184; Water 556,343 + 29,171 = 585,514; Sewer 495,591 + 3,029 = 498,620; Ethanol 102,228; sum 6,256,098 = gap exactly. 213,819 + 6,256,098 = 6,469,917 = statement total (operating expenses 6,413,634 + interest expense 56,283). Each column's lines were re-added and tie to its printed Total operating expenses.
